summary: Today's briefing highlights critical legal rulings and significant developments in the retail sector, particularly focusing on liability and operational expansions.

bullets.text: Karnataka High Court denied relief to a man whose minor son caused a car crash killing three people.
Flipkart plans to launch a food delivery service to compete with Zomato and Swiggy.
MillD aims to increase production capacity tenfold with a new Bengaluru plant, targeting ₹700 crore revenue by FY29.
Mukesh Ambani's Jio seeks a $108 billion valuation in a record Indian IPO.
OYO-parent PRISM reduces IPO fresh issue size from ₹6,650 crore to ₹3,350 crore due to strong cash flow.
